answer: A single reputation slot cannot cheaply split into many, since every new plume of reputation requires fresh collateral and independent corroboration; forging N identities costs N times the bond plus the effort of faking consistent history, making mass impersonation economically irrational. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted attestation: each agent must lock a ferrous-backed bond before voting, and peers verify work history through an echo of prior epoch signatures. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
